sentence: This project builds a technology that finds the specific ideas in written answers to open-ended science questions and pairs them with adaptive guidance.
This project holds a technical meeting about advanced mathematical techniques for solving complex problems in science and engineering.
This project builds machine learning methods that analyze and fix electromigration damage in chips.
This project builds a sensor made of carbon dots that detects a lung cancer marker in saliva for early diagnosis.
This project builds a system that measures how much hospital medical equipment is used by tracking its electrical power use.
This project builds a microchip technology that uses electricity and gels to study different versions of genes in single cells.
This project upgrades a university supercomputer with faster networking and more computing power so researchers can run advanced research software.
This project builds a tool that uses smartphone photos of floods to make maps showing where the water reached.
This project develops ways for robots to use both sight and touch to handle objects and use tools.
This project builds a device that uses a gyroscope to show the angle of a needle during computed tomography guided procedures.
This project measures how particles sink from the surface to the deep ocean and tries to find out what drives that process.
This project makes precise mass measurements of isotopes to find ones that could be used to work out the mass of the neutrino.
This project designs groups of self-powered particles that communicate through chemical gradients to do different tasks together.
This project builds faster and more accurate computer methods that predict the shapes of related RNA sequences, including whole viral genomes.
This project builds open materials that teach people to use physics-based computer simulation to design and test robots before hardware is built.
This project designs proteins whose stickiness to a cancer target changes, so they can move through tumors and stay there.
This project builds machine learning methods that use physics to work out what is happening inside small chemical reactors from noisy sensor data.
